input: Ik maak een publiccode.yml (versie 0.7 van de standaard) voor de repository https://github.com/Geonovum/technisch-register-2019 op commit 7cc32f97d4711fe41842b653a4ef1e57af95932a. Welke waarden horen bij legal.license, legal.mainCopyrightOwner, softwareType en landingURL? Antwoord met alleen een JSON-object met de sleutels "license", "mainCopyrightOwner", "softwareType" en "landingURL".

metadata.hypothesis: Software of the Dutch government is mostly EUPL-1.2, and so is the template of the repo-docs-generator of developer.overheid.nl that makes publiccode.yml. The LICENSE of this repository is MIT. softwareType must be one of the values of the standard, standalone/web for a website, and the landing URL is the site the README names, not the GitHub URL
metadata.location: LICENSE (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2019 Geonovum), the first line of README.md, and the key softwareType in the publiccode.yml standard
